text: Need a better way to handle merging form responses into custom documents and PDFs, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord?
Watch Form2Docx in action: Place simple {{Question Title}} tags anywhere in your Google Doc header, body, or tables and watch Form2Docx populate them automatically on submit.

Output an editable Google Doc, a locked print-ready PDF, or both directly into your designated Google Drive destination folder. Plus, name generated files automatically using form answers—such as "2026-Contract-{{Client Name}}.pdf"—and log the direct Drive link back into your Sheet.
Your legal, medical, and client intake answers never leave your Google account—and your generated PDFs never carry third-party promotional stamps.
Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
